summary: The World Ends with You entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: The World Ends with You
entries.definitive_edition: The World Ends with You: Final Remix on Nintendo Switch, with DS original documented for combat design

emulation.notes: Use native Switch route for primary; DS route only for original-control comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Switch Final Remix for content; original DS hardware for dual-screen design

primary.version: The World Ends with You: Final Remix
primary.why: Final Remix is the most complete current route: it is the definitive version, with an extra chapter, exclusive two-player combat, new remixed music, and content from the DS and mobile versions. The DS original remains vital for the original dual-screen combat design.
primary.how_to_play: Use Final Remix on Switch. Record patch, touch/Joy-Con control mode, TV/handheld mode, co-op use, extra chapter completion, pin/Noise reports, and whether DS original dual-screen combat was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original dual-screen combat and input design
secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting the original control/combat experience.
secondary.why: Final Remix is more complete, but the DS version has a distinct battle interface.
Final Remix supersedes it for current content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record control mode and whether the extra chapter and two-player combat were used.
